description: A shell script for testing 'git show' command behavior, including setup, various test cases for displaying commits, trees, tags, ranges, and merge states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with setup or verification steps.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit, possibly with a specified message or directory.

methods.name: test_merge
methods.description: Performs a merge operation between branches.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.
